The individuals presented in these videos may be suffering from the effects of alcohol, drug abuse, a mental health disorder or simply having a bad day. The videos should NOT be presumed to be representative of their general behavior. Everyone deserves to be treated with respect. 

RIGHT TO BE FORGOTTEN:
Midwest Safety practices the "Right to be Forgotten." If you were the suspect in a lower-level offense, you may email our board to request removal. 
Email: contact@midwest-safety.com

The Ohio State Fire Marshal determined the blaze had been intentionally set. Investigators documented a lighter inside the home and extensive fire damage near the wood-burning stove. Now, officers do train through high-risk scenarios based exercises designed to force rapid decisions under extreme stress to protect life. And you see that training carried through even after the shot stopped. Dragging the suspect out of a burning house knowing the outcome. That's not impulse, that's discipline. alleged_crimes.label: Threatening to kill with a knife

event_summary.short: Deputies responded to a hostage situation where a man threatened his sister with a knife and set the house on fire; officers shot and killed the suspect.
